questions.question: In his letter to the Galatians, Paul said some people pushed circumcision to avoid what?

answers.text: Persecution for the cross of Christ
A heavy fine from the council

questions.question: In his letter to the Galatians, Paul said he would never boast except in what?

answers.text: The cross of our Lord Jesus Christ

questions.question: Paul told the Galatians that neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. What does count?
At the end of his letter to the Galatians, what did Paul wish would be with their spirit?

answers.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
The strength of our father Abraham
The wisdom of the prophets of old
